items.title: Specificity is a tuple comparison, not a sum
items.description: Specificity is compared column by column (ids, then classes, then elements) with no carrying between columns — it is never collapsed into one additive score. Drag the sliders to see how this selector's (id, class) tuple compares against a fixed baseline selector with 1 id and 0 classes (like `#page .btn`): +1 means this selector wins, -1 means it loses, 0 means a tie on both columns shown here. Notice that with 0 ids, the outcome stays -1 no matter how high you push the class count.
items.compute: const REF_ID = 1; const REF_CLASS = 0; let outcome; if (params.idCount !== REF_ID) { outcome = params.idCount > REF_ID ? 1 : -1; } else if (params.classCount !== REF_CLASS) { outcome = params.classCount > REF_CLASS ? 1 : -1; } else { outcome = 0; } return { outcome };
